angle.1.question: How much does it cost, who pays, and what gets displaced?
angle.1.title: Costs
angle.10.question: What breaks if it fails? How is failure detected? Can it be reversed?
angle.10.title: Blast-radius (⭐)
angle.11.question: What contract was agreed, and does every path honor it?
angle.11.title: Contracts and invariants (⭐)
angle.2.question: What can go wrong if abused? Does it request more permissions than necessary?
angle.2.title: Security
angle.3.question: Where does the data come from? What if it is false or stale?
angle.3.title: Data/honesty
angle.4.question: Who bears the cost? Is the affected person respected?
angle.4.title: People/autonomy
angle.5.question: What if the provider fails, raises prices or disappears?
angle.5.title: Dependencies
angle.6.question: Does it work for all users, including those with degraded access?
angle.6.title: UX/accessibility
angle.7.question: Is it permitted, under which license, and what does the law say?
angle.7.title: Legal/licensing
angle.8.question: Who does what, in which order, and what if someone fails?
angle.8.title: Coordination
angle.9.question: Is contrary evidence sought, or only supporting evidence?
angle.9.title: Author bias (⭐)
